scenario.description: Two tasks cancelled with Timeout while sleeping acknowledge at a checkpoint and keep running: at acknowledgement the Timeout cleanup budget (500 polls) replaces their budgets, and it is advisory. t.within ends its cleanup after 300 more polls, Cancelled(Timeout); t.over runs 520, the spent cleanup quota strengthens its reason to PollQuota at a pre-poll, and it still runs to its end: no force-complete (bd-9kll.3.2).
